newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAL plane hits turbulence, 11 injured.
newsitem.headline: JAL plane hits turbulence, 11 injured.

text.p: Eleven people were injured when a Japan Airlines (JAL) passenger jet hit turbulence on Sunday on its way to the central Japanese city of Nagoya from Hong Kong, an airline spokesman said on Monday.

The MD-11 aircraft, with 169 passengers and 11 crew members aboard, hit the turbulence at 7.50 p.m. (1050 GMT) on Sunday, about 25 minutes before its scheduled arrival at Nagoya airport, the spokesman said.
Three passengers and eight flight attendants were injured, he said. A 33-year-old flight attendant was seriously injured with a fractured pelvis, he added.
No foreigners were among the injured, he said.
The accident took place when JAL Flight 706 was descending from an altitude of 5,200 metres (17,000 feet), he said.
